def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_list = instance["customer_ids"]
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    def route_load(rt):
        s = 0
        for n in rt:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def route_cost(rt):
        if not rt:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][rt[0]] + matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(rt) - 1):
            c += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes)

    # If somehow demands indexed by customer_ids only, use direct indexing above.
    # Assume distance_matrix uses same node ids.
    # Deterministic Clarke-Wright savings with constrained merges.
    routes = [[i] for i in customers_list if demands[i] <= capacity]
    used = set()
    for i in customers_list:
        if demands[i] <= capacity:
            used.add(i)

    # If any customer is infeasible alone, force them out (should not happen in valid CVRP).
    # Keep deterministic: skip those.
    all_customers = set(customers_list)
    remaining = list(sorted(all_customers - used))

    cust2route = {}
    for rid, rt in enumerate(routes):
        cust2route[rt[0]] = rid

    # Build savings list.
    # Sort deterministically: higher savings first, then smaller ids.
    custs = sorted(used)
    savings = []
    for a in custs:
        da = matrix[depot][a]
        for b in custs:
            if b == a:
                continue
            s = da + matrix[depot][b] - matrix[a][b]
            savings.append((s, a, b))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))

    # Track loads for speed.
    loads = [route_load(rt) for rt in routes]

    def can_merge(ri, rj, a, b):
        # a must be at end of route ri, b at start of route rj
        if a != routes[ri][-1]:
            return False
        if b != routes[rj][0]:
            return False
        return loads[ri] + loads[rj] <= capacity

    # Merge until no more merges.
    # We'll maintain for each route whether it is active (not merged into others).
    active = [True] * len(routes)
    for s, i, j in savings:
        if not (i in cust2route and j in cust2route):
            continue
        ri = cust2route[i]
        rj = cust2route[j]
        if ri == rj:
            continue
        if not (active[ri] and active[rj]):
            continue
        if can_merge(ri, rj, i, j):
            # Merge rj into ri: ri_end = i, rj_start = j
            routes[ri].extend(routes[rj])
            loads[ri] += loads[rj]
            active[rj] = False
            # Update cust2route mapping for moved customers in rj
            for node in routes[rj]:
                cust2route[node] = ri
            # route index of old rj endpoints updated via mapping above

    # Collect active routes
    routes = [routes[i] for i in range(len(routes)) if active[i]]

    # Insert any remaining (should be none); use deterministic best position insertion.
    # Use "cheapest feasible insertion" into route with minimal added cost.
    for node in sorted(remaining):
        best_r = None
        best_pos = None
        best_delta = None
        for rid in range(len(routes)):
            if loads[rid] + demands[node] > capacity:
                continue
        # If routes were rebuilt, recompute loads after merge
        loads = [route_load(rt) for rt in routes]
        for rid in range(len(routes)):
            if loads[rid] + demands[node] > capacity:
                continue
            rt = routes[rid]
            # Try all insertion positions
            m = len(rt)
            for pos in range(m + 1):
                # compute incremental cost deterministically
                if m == 0:
                    delta = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
                else:
                    if pos == 0:
                        delta = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][rt[0]] - matrix[depot][rt[0]]
                    elif pos == m:
                        delta = matrix[rt[-1]][node] + matrix[node][depot] - matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
                    else:
                        a = rt[pos - 1]
                        b = rt[pos]
                        delta = matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b] - matrix[a][b]
                if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and (rid, pos) < (best_r, best_pos)):
                    best_delta = delta
                    best_r = rid
                    best_pos = pos
        if best_r is None:
            # No feasible route found; create a new route if feasible (deterministic)
            if demands[node] <= capacity:
                routes.append([node])
                loads.append(demands[node])
            else:
                # Give up deterministically
                continue
        else:
            routes[best_r].insert(best_pos, node)
            loads[best_r] += demands[node]

    # Local search: intra-route 2-opt + inter-route relocate (deterministic first-improvement).
    # Keep it conservative for determinism and runtime.
    def two_opt_on_route(rt):
        m = len(rt)
        if m < 4:
            return rt, False
        improved = False
        best_delta = 0
        # First-improvement scan
        current_cost = route_cost(rt)
        for i in range(m - 1):
            for k in range(i + 1, m):
                # Reverse segment [i..k]
                new_rt = rt[:i] + rt[i:k + 1][::-1] + rt[k + 1:]
                # Capacity unchanged
                new_cost = route_cost(new_rt)
                delta = new_cost - current_cost
                if delta < -1e-9:
                    return new_rt, True
        return rt, improved

    def try_relocate(routes, loads):
        # Deterministic: for each source route in order, for each customer position,
        # try inserting into best feasible position of target route in order; take first improving move.
        rcount = len(routes)
        base_total = total_cost(routes)
        for ra in range(rcount):

                demand_node = demands[node]
                new_load_a = loads[ra] - demand_node

                src_after = routes[ra][:pa] + routes[ra][pa + 1:]

                    # Determine best insertion position in deterministic order for this (ra,rb,node)
                    best_pos = None
                    best_delta = None
                    # Evaluate all positions
                    if m == 0:
                        positions = [0]
                    else:
                        positions = list(range(m + 1))
                    # Current costs
                    cost_a_before = route_cost(routes[ra])
                    cost_b_before = route_cost(routes[rb])
                    cost_a_after = route_cost(src_after)
                    for pos in positions:
                        if m == 0:
                            rt_new_b = [node]
                        else:
                            rt_new_b = rt_b[:pos] + [node] + rt_b[pos:]
                        cost_b_after = route_cost(rt_new_b)
                        delta = (cost_a_after + cost_b_after) - (cost_a_before + cost_b_before)
                        if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and pos < best_pos):
                            best_delta = delta
                            best_pos = pos
                    if best_delta is not None and best_delta < -1e-9:
                        routes[ra] = src_after
                        routes[rb] = rt_b[:best_pos] + [node] + rt_b[best_pos:]
                        loads[ra] = new_load_a
                        loads[rb] += demand_node
                        # Remove empty routes deterministically (but keep indices stable by filtering later)
                        return True
        return False

    # Apply a few deterministic passes; conservative number to avoid time blowup.
    # Intra 2-opt per route
    for _ in range(2):
        changed = False
        for idx in range(len(routes)):
            new_rt, ok = two_opt_on_route(routes[idx])
            if ok:
                routes[idx] = new_rt
                changed = True
        if not changed:
            break

    # Inter-route relocate passes
    loads = [route_load(rt) for rt in routes]
    for _ in range(3):
        # Filter empties first
        if any(len(rt) == 0 for rt in routes):
            new_routes = []
            new_loads = []
            for r, l in zip(routes, loads):
                if r:
                    new_routes.append(r)
                    new_loads.append(l)
            routes, loads = new_routes, new_loads
        if len(routes) <= 1:
            break
        if not try_relocate(routes, loads):
            break

    # Final cleanup: remove empty routes
    routes = [rt for rt in routes if rt]

    return routes
